text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to a ramen shop,
a familiar trio was working there.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up!!
Welcome, welcomeee!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please take any seat you like.
I will be right over to take your order.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...
How did things end up like this again?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
There's a huge event happening nearby
soon?! I see,
you definitely can't let a chance like that
slip by!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taishin! Hayahide!!
Let's save the ramen shop together!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I am—WE are,
THE RAMEN SHOPPPPPP~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So in the end,
things played out like they always do.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your order has been placed.
Please wait a moment
while it's being prepared—yes, water?
Right away.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting! Two rich shoyu ramens,
firm noodles... Wait, extra chashu pork?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, this might be bad.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Next, take that order over there,
bus the table—wait, no,
I have to bring water to the new customers
first!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is bad, this is bad, Hayahideee!!
My head is spinning out of controool~~!!
Wh-What am I gonna dooo!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I can see the fatigue setting in on Taishin
in the kitchen.
This seems like a good stopping point.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Ticket, Taishin!! We will now
execute 'Operation B-III'!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The cause of the confusion is primarily the
crowded hall.
With irregular cases piling onto normal
duties, the whole operation is under
strain. We'll put a stop to that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait... which means?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—I shall execute all floor duties
in one seamless sequence of actions!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What?! Just HOW did you do that?!?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
First,
assess the whole floor. Memorize who's
ready to order, about to finish,
or ready for the bill,
and stand by.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The moment an order is called,
operation begins.
Grab the ordering tablet and water pitcher,
take down the order,
and refill waters while clearing away finished
plates.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In short,
you conserve stamina and keep reserves
ready to handle the unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But, but,
that sounds super tough...!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but in theory,
this should settle the confusion.
All that's left now—is execution!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I hold a tray with three bowls of ramen
in one hand,
and a water pitcher in the other...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All right! Food served and water refilled!
Keeping my pivot foot in place,
I'll clear all the dishes
from Table 2, and that'llâ

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Table secured! Four new guests
coming in! Welcome, everyone!!

Keeping her pivot foot planted in the center
of the hall,
Biwa Hayahide moves dynamically.
Thanks to her efforts,
table turnover has skyrocketed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way... It's really spinning!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, you're incredible, Hayahideee~~!!
Your theories really are the absolute
greatest~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, it's less of a theory and more like...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's muscles, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's overrr!! That was tough, but
the part-time job was fun!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Especially Hayahide,
she was so ammmaaazing!!
Like *whoosh-whoosh*!!
And *bam-bam-bam-bam*!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
today was about as stiflingly intense as
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Hayahide's just been really
intense all around lately, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ..."Passionate," huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Ticket, Taishin!!
We will now execute 'Plan Beta'!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The cause of the confusion is primarily the
crowded hall.
With irregular cases piling onto normal
duties, the whole operation is under
strain. We'll put a stop to that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: With the teamwork of all three of us!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa!! Teamwork, right?!
Got it, I'll do my besttt!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket!
Widen your stride!
Carry more ramen in a single step!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehh?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Taishin,
take the front! Once the crowd is in,
you need to predict how the race will unfold
and move!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, not good! A tour group! Everyone,
stay calm and
handle them—welcome to the shop!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's overrr!! That was tough, but
the part-time job was fun!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Especially Hayahide,
she was so ammmaaazing!!
Like *whoosh-whoosh*!!
And *bam-bam-bam-bam*!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
today was about as stiflingly intense as
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Hayahide's just been really
intense all around lately, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ..."Passionate," huh.
